title: Encrypted SNI, checked against its first draft
claim: Modeled on draft-rescorla-tls-esni-00. A method comprising: encrypting the server name in the TLS handshake; obtaining the key for that encryption from DNS; sending a hash of the server name instead of the name; letting a front server decrypt the hello and hand the connection to a backend; and publishing the key in a blockchain.
